crawl.about: Hauls itself along the ground, hand over hand, with its legs trailing

crawl_attack.about: Rears up on its left arm and rakes with its right; it lands on frame 16

walk_shamble.about: Head-heavy trudge, scuffs its toes, arms hanging dead

walk_drag.about: Ruined right leg, locked and turned out: hauls with the left, the toe scrapes after it

walk_reach.about: Hungry: arms up and grasping unevenly, legs locked straight, chin thrust out

walk_stagger.about: Always nearly falling: four uneven steps, one crossing over, flung arms

run_charge.about: Flat-out sprint, pitched far forward, arms thrashing out of time

run_lope.about: Heavy loose bounding, head rolling and arms flung about like dead weight

run_hobble.about: Broken run: bounds off the right, swings the locked left wide, left arm clamped to its chest

run_frenzy.about: Grasping sprint: bent double, driving off its toes, clawing at its prey in turn

attack_rake.about: Elbow hauled up behind its head, drives off the back leg, rakes down across the body

attack_flurry.about: Marches in, a foot planting on each of three wild rakes, the hips turning before the chest

attack_bite.about: Lunges, clamps on at shoulder height, hauls in and worries the bite from its chest

attack_pounce.about: Coils, leaps flat with hands driving up to hit at shoulder height on frame 27, drops into a crouch raking
